title: How To Visit STARBASE // A Complete Guide To Seeing Starship!
summary: Everyday Astronaut's guide to visiting Starbase, Texas to see Starship, covering what and where it is, which areas close during launches, where to watch from, where to fly into and stay, and things to do.
why: Recommended as the practical guide for anyone planning to attend a Starship launch in person.

quote.text: Everyday Astronaut did a great writeup on seeing a launch in South Texas
